notes: Recorded by W1 follow-up 1 (task_label W1-followup-1); the task field is left out because run@1 accepts only W<n>-S<nn> or W<n>-T<nn> there.

Each configuration ran in its own fresh server: docker run -d of postgres:18@sha256:74935e72241653ca55e0414067e6d8763aceb8a810eb51b452253ec3dcfc4336 with --network none, --memory=6g and trust authentication, the work directory mounted read-only at /q; the recorder waited until docker logs showed "PostgreSQL init process complete" and "database system is ready to accept connections" twice and pg_isready exited 0 (at most 120 polls, 0.5 s apart), then ran psql through docker exec and sh with stdout and stderr merged by 2>&1, so the log is in the order psql wrote it, and removed the container. argv lists the commands in order (start, prelude when there is one, psql, removal); started_at, duration_s and exit_code are the psql command's. psql ran with -X and -v VERBOSITY=verbose, so each ERROR line carries its SQLSTATE; the SQL files ran unchanged, several -f files in one psql session.

The template world (world-*.sql) is generated by the recorder from scripts/spikes/W0-S08/rls-spec.mjs, the harness W0-S08 wrote for these specimens (docs/spikes/W0-S08.md asks W4-T10 to reuse it): ROLE_SETUP, SCHEMA_SETUP_AS_SUPERUSER, SCHEMA_SETUP_AS_OWNER as app_owner, the reference world WORLD_W0 (Acme and Birch; Payments, Growth, Legal and Risk; dana, frank, gia, hal, eli, ivy; contract, layoffs-memo, q3-plan, roadmap), and policies. It ran as the prelude, with ON_ERROR_STOP=1, as the superuser postgres; the cell then ran in a new psql session as postgres, as a tab cell runs as its superuser. documents is owned by app_owner, so `SET ROLE app_owner` makes the cell's query run as the table owner.

values.owner_rows_noforce lists the ids the owner's query returned before FORCE (all four documents of the world); values.owner_rows_force those after FORCE: roadmap only, frank's row of the access matrix (frank is a viewer on Growth, which owns roadmap). values.flags_after_force is the pg_class read-back, with the server's now() at the read.
The tab runs this cell on PGlite; PGlite was not run for this record. Placeholder in argv: <sandbox>/work is a scratch copy of the inputs this record lists, mounted at /q.
